dialogues.jp: ようやくテストが終わった。
dialogues.en: Finally, that test ended.
dialogues.text: Finally, that test ended.

dialogues.jp:
その心地よさに思わず外の空気を胸いっぱいに
吸い込む。
dialogues.en: Unconsciously, I let out a huge sigh of relief.
dialogues.text: Unconsciously, I let out a huge sigh of relief.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、終わっただけで、内容についてはあまり
触れたくはないので、開放感のみが心地よさの
理由だ。
dialogues.en:
Not just from that pressure finally being over, but from the
fact that everything that was tested, I knew how to do.
dialogues.text:
Not just from that pressure finally being over, but from the
fact that everything that was tested, I knew how to do.

dialogues.jp:
俺も、眞子のように、達成感に溢れた笑顔を振
りまいてみたいものだ。
dialogues.en:
My smile was filled with pride. Mako, next to me then,
displayed the same kind of smile.
dialogues.text:
My smile was filled with pride. Mako, next to me then,
displayed the same kind of smile.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、逆に杉並みたいに、解放感も達成感もま
るでなく、いつもの授業を受けるような顔をし
て、高得点をたたき出すのもどうかと思うが。
dialogues.en:
Whereas Suginami didn't carry either achievement or relief
in his expression, and instead one of studying, the mark of
a top-scorer.
dialogues.text:
Whereas Suginami didn't carry either achievement or relief
in his expression, and instead one of studying, the mark of
a top-scorer.

dialogues.jp:
さっさと帰るのもいいのだが、もう少し余韻を
味わいたいと、ジュースを買ってベンチに座る。
dialogues.en:
I should be heading back to class soon, but for just a
little longer, I wanted to continue drinking my juice here.
dialogues.text:
I should be heading back to class soon, but for just a
little longer, I wanted to continue drinking my juice here.

dialogues.jp:
風に乗って、桜の花びらが舞うところなど、思
わず、
dialogues.en:
A gust of wind blew a bunch of sakura petals past me, and I
started talking to myself.
dialogues.text:
A gust of wind blew a bunch of sakura petals past me, and I
started talking to myself.

dialogues.jp: 「よきかな、よきかな」
dialogues.en: "Haha, how typical."
dialogues.text: "Haha, how typical."

dialogues.jp: などと高笑いをしてみたくなるほど、風流だ。
dialogues.en: With a hearty laugh, I breathed in the cool air.
dialogues.text: With a hearty laugh, I breathed in the cool air.

dialogues.jp: 思わず京都名物を作って食べてしまう。
dialogues.en: It was like tasting some of Kyoto's delicacies.
dialogues.text: It was like tasting some of Kyoto's delicacies.

dialogues.jp: 「この甘さが心地いい」
dialogues.en: "This feeling is the best!"
dialogues.text: "This feeling is the best!"

dialogues.jp:
あーんと口に入れているところに、ふと視線を
感じた。
dialogues.en:
Opening my mouth wide to breathe in further, my eyes caught
onto something peculiar.
dialogues.text:
Opening my mouth wide to breathe in further, my eyes caught
onto something peculiar.

dialogues.jp: 「え、あ、月城？」
dialogues.en: "Eh, ah, Tsukishiro?"
dialogues.text: "Eh, ah, Tsukishiro?"

dialogues.jp: み、見られてないよなぁ……。
dialogues.en: S, she didn't see anything, I'm sure...
dialogues.text: S, she didn't see anything, I'm sure...

dialogues.jp: 「や、やあ、月城。テストはどうだった？」
dialogues.en: "H, hey, Tsukishiro. Did you do well on your tests?"
dialogues.text: "H, hey, Tsukishiro. Did you do well on your tests?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...I did."
dialogues.text: "...I did."

dialogues.jp:
彼女は、黒い手袋を外すと、ピロスを触り、俺
の方に向ける。
dialogues.en:
Once again, her black gloves came off, and her bare hands
stroked her doll, which soon turned to face me.
dialogues.text:
Once again, her black gloves came off, and her bare hands
stroked her doll, which soon turned to face me.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「テストはできたよ。いつも通り」
dialogues.en: "The tests were fine, as usual."
dialogues.text: "The tests were fine, as usual."

dialogues.jp:
月城の喋る人形──かどうかはわからないけれ
ど、まあ腹話術に違いない。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro's talking doll-- although she doesn't explain it,
there's no doubt it's ventriloquism.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro's talking doll-- although she doesn't explain it,
there's no doubt it's ventriloquism.

dialogues.jp: そうでなかったら、それはそれで怖いのだが。
dialogues.en: But even so, her ability at it is scary...
dialogues.text: But even so, her ability at it is scary...

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「先輩はここで何してるの？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing here, senpai?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing here, senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「すぐ帰るのもかったるいから、ここでのんび
　り休んでるんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Going back to class so soon seemed troublesome, so I stayed
out here to relax a bit."
dialogues.text:
"Going back to class so soon seemed troublesome, so I stayed
out here to relax a bit."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ジュースを飲み干し、近くのゴミ箱へ放
り投げる。
dialogues.en:
Drinking up the last of my juice, I threw the bottle into a
nearby trash basket.
dialogues.text:
Drinking up the last of my juice, I threw the bottle into a
nearby trash basket.

dialogues.jp: 「ところで、月城は時間差で喋ったりできる？」
dialogues.en: "And you must spend lots of your time practicing, right?"
dialogues.text: "And you must spend lots of your time practicing, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、テレビで見るじゃない。口パクと声の
　聞こえてくるタイミングがズレて聞こえてく
　るヤツ」
dialogues.en:
"You know, how to project your voice using a barely visible
gap in your mouth to make it look like someone else is
talking."
dialogues.text:
"You know, how to project your voice using a barely visible
gap in your mouth to make it look like someone else is
talking."

dialogues.jp: 月城の首がいつもより余計に傾く。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro's head tilted to the side, in confusion.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro's head tilted to the side, in confusion.

dialogues.jp: 「違うのか……」
dialogues.en: "Or not, huh..."
dialogues.text: "Or not, huh..."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「先輩は変なことを言うんだね」
dialogues.en: "You're acting weird today, senpai."
dialogues.text: "You're acting weird today, senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「いや、別に他意があった訳じゃない」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry, I'm not hiding anything."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry, I'm not hiding anything."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「で、月城はここでなにしてるんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, what about you? What are you doing here,
Tsukishiro?"
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, what about you? What are you doing here,
Tsukishiro?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「お昼をここで食べようと思って」
dialogues.en: "We thought of eating lunch here."
dialogues.text: "We thought of eating lunch here."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「今日は、午後には誰もいないから、お弁当を
　作ってもらったんだ」
dialogues.en:
"We figured that no one would come here during lunchtime, so
we made a lunchbox to eat here."
dialogues.text:
"We figured that no one would come here during lunchtime, so
we made a lunchbox to eat here."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、鞄の中から、小さな弁当箱を取りだし
て見せてくれた。
dialogues.en:
I then noticed Tsukishiro taking out a tiny lunchbox from
her bag.
dialogues.text:
I then noticed Tsukishiro taking out a tiny lunchbox from
her bag.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「学食もいいけど、あそこは人が多いから」
dialogues.en:
"The cafeteria would normally be fine, but there's a lot of
people there today."
dialogues.text:
"The cafeteria would normally be fine, but there's a lot of
people there today."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、人が多いとイヤなのか？」
dialogues.en: "Huh, you don't like being with many people?"
dialogues.text: "Huh, you don't like being with many people?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「先輩は平気なの？」
dialogues.en: "You're fine with it, senpai?"
dialogues.text: "You're fine with it, senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「その方が楽しいだろ」
dialogues.en: "The more, the merrier."
dialogues.text: "The more, the merrier."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……知らない人ばかりだと、イヤだな」
dialogues.en: "...It's not nice, with so many strangers."
dialogues.text: "...It's not nice, with so many strangers."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「知ってる人だといいんだろ？」
dialogues.en: "It'd be fine if there's some people you know, right?"
dialogues.text: "It'd be fine if there's some people you know, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「うん、最近は時々隣のクラスの天枷さんが、
　誘いに来るから」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, recently, Amakase-san from the neighbouring class has
been inviting us to her class."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, recently, Amakase-san from the neighbouring class has
been inviting us to her class."

dialogues.jp: 美春のヤツ……、そんなことをしてるのか。
dialogues.en: That Miharu... so she's been doing that.
dialogues.text: That Miharu... so she's been doing that.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「先輩、隣に座っていい？」
dialogues.en: "Is it okay to sit beside you, senpai?"
dialogues.text: "Is it okay to sit beside you, senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「かまわないよ」
dialogues.en: "No problems here."
dialogues.text: "No problems here."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ、座らせてもらうね」
dialogues.en: "Then we will!"
dialogues.text: "Then we will!"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、俺と自分の間に人形を置き、その上に
外した手袋を置いた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro placed her doll on the bench as well, then put
her gloves back on, and took a seat.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro placed her doll on the bench as well, then put
her gloves back on, and took a seat.

dialogues.jp: 膝の上に、弁当箱を広げる。
dialogues.en: She then opened the lunchbox on her lap.
dialogues.text: She then opened the lunchbox on her lap.

dialogues.jp: 小さな小さな弁当箱だ。
dialogues.en: What a tiny, tiny lunchbox...
dialogues.text: What a tiny, tiny lunchbox...

dialogues.jp: 「俺はいてもいいのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is it okay for me to be here?"
dialogues.text: "Is it okay for me to be here?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「そっか」
dialogues.en: "Alright."
dialogues.text: "Alright."

dialogues.jp:
月城の弁当箱の中身は、ふりかけで作ったおに
ぎりと、たまご焼きとタコさんウインナーだっ
た。後はにんじんの甘く煮たのが入っていた。
dialogues.en:
Her lunch consisted of onigiri seasoned with fish flour,
fried egg, octopus sausages, and fried carrots.
dialogues.text:
Her lunch consisted of onigiri seasoned with fish flour,
fried egg, octopus sausages, and fried carrots.

dialogues.jp: 「可愛い弁当だな」
dialogues.en: "Cute lunchbox."
dialogues.text: "Cute lunchbox."

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷く月城。
dialogues.en: The same old nod.
dialogues.text: The same old nod.

dialogues.jp:
「……まさか、瀬場さんが作った訳じゃないよ
　なぁ」
dialogues.en: "...Wait a minute, did Seiba-san make this?"
dialogues.text: "...Wait a minute, did Seiba-san make this?"

dialogues.jp: 月城は、何も言わずにたまご焼きを口へ運ぶ。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro remained silent, chewing on the fried egg.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro remained silent, chewing on the fried egg.

dialogues.jp:
まさかなぁ、あの大きな瀬場さんが、こんな小
さくて可愛らしいお弁当を作るなんてな。
dialogues.en:
How on earth could such a tiny cute lunchbox be made by such
a hulking big man like Seiba-san?
dialogues.text:
How on earth could such a tiny cute lunchbox be made by such
a hulking big man like Seiba-san?

dialogues.jp:
あのいかつい手が、あの小さな俵おにぎりを作っ
たり、赤いウインナーに包丁を入れたり……。
dialogues.en:
Those beefy hands, rolling up those small onigiris,
skillfully cutting up the red sausages...
dialogues.text:
Those beefy hands, rolling up those small onigiris,
skillfully cutting up the red sausages...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……どうしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "...What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "...What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「え？　あ、いやぁ。おいしそうなお弁当だと
　思ってね」
dialogues.en:
"Eh? Ah, nothing... just thinking that your lunch looks
delicious."
dialogues.text:
"Eh? Ah, nothing... just thinking that your lunch looks
delicious."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……食べますか？」
dialogues.en: "...You want to eat it?"
dialogues.text: "...You want to eat it?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「食べますか……って、そんな小さな弁当、
　ちょっともらっただけでなくなりそうじゃ
　ないか」
dialogues.en:
"That's... well, such a tiny lunch won't be enough for me,
anyway."
dialogues.text:
"That's... well, such a tiny lunch won't be enough for me,
anyway."

dialogues.jp:
月城の弁当は５回口に放り込んだら、なくなり
そうな量だった。
dialogues.en: It'd take 5 lunchboxes like that before I'd be full.
dialogues.text: It'd take 5 lunchboxes like that before I'd be full.

dialogues.jp:
「ほら、月城は、ちゃんと食べないと、大きく
　なれないぞ。ただでさえ小さいんだから」
dialogues.en:
"Besides, Tsukishiro, if you don't eat, you won't get any
bigger. You're so tiny already."
dialogues.text:
"Besides, Tsukishiro, if you don't eat, you won't get any
bigger. You're so tiny already."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp:
小さな口を動かして、もくもくと弁当を食べる
月城。なんだか、娘をピクニックに連れてきて
るお父さんみたいだな。
dialogues.en:
She continued eating her lunch, her tiny mouth slowly
chewing her food. I must look like a father with his
daughter on a picnic...
dialogues.text:
She continued eating her lunch, her tiny mouth slowly
chewing her food. I must look like a father with his
daughter on a picnic...

dialogues.jp:
「飯、食い終わったら、あの草を見に行くんだ
　ろ？　俺、暇だから一緒に行こう」
dialogues.en:
"After you're done eating, want to go see the plant? I don't
have anything else to do."
dialogues.text:
"After you're done eating, want to go see the plant? I don't
have anything else to do."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、おにぎりをたべながら、不思議そうな
顔で俺を見ていたが、しばらくして、
dialogues.en:
I caught her in the middle of her eating her onigiri, and
she looked at me with a surprised face. After a while,
dialogues.text:
I caught her in the middle of her eating her onigiri, and
she looked at me with a surprised face. After a while,

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp: と言った。心なしか、彼女が笑って見えた。
dialogues.en:
So, she said. It may have been my imagination, but I thought
I saw her smile.
dialogues.text:
So, she said. It may have been my imagination, but I thought
I saw her smile.

dialogues.jp: ◆ランチタイム◆
dialogues.en: ◆Lunchtime◆
dialogues.text: ◆Lunchtime◆

dialogues.jp:
昼休憩、ベンチでくつろいでいると、月城が
やってきた。
dialogues.en:
It was lunchtime, and I was relaxing on the bench, when
Tsukishiro appeared.
dialogues.text:
It was lunchtime, and I was relaxing on the bench, when
Tsukishiro appeared.

dialogues.jp:
どうやら、人が多いところで、食事をするのは
イヤだから、ここで食べたいということらしい。
dialogues.en:
It seems she didn't want to eat where lots of people were,
so she came here.
dialogues.text:
It seems she didn't want to eat where lots of people were,
so she came here.

dialogues.jp:
俺がいるのは、いいのかと聞くと、俺はいても
いいらしい。
dialogues.en: I was here, but according to her, that was fine.
dialogues.text: I was here, but according to her, that was fine.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、食事が終わったら、一緒にあの草を見に
行こうと誘ったのだった。
dialogues.en:
I invited her to go see the plant together, after she
finished her lunch.
dialogues.text:
I invited her to go see the plant together, after she
finished her lunch.
